_comment: Server-sent message text (e-mail, SMS). {placeholders} are filled by the server. Never put patient names here; the patient's name is only added by the hospital connector.

staffInvite.subject: You are invited to NeuroCapture for {hospital}
staffInvite.body:
You have been added to NeuroCapture for {hospital} as {role}.

Set your password here (the link works once and expires in {days} days):
{link}

After that you will set up two-step sign-in with an authenticator app.

patientInviteEmail.subject: {hospital} invites you to record movement tests at home
patientInviteEmail.body:
{hospital} has invited you to record short movement tests at home with the NeuroCapture app.

Open this link on your phone, or scan the QR code attached (it works once and expires in {days} days):
{link}

You will then choose a PIN. You do not need your MRN.

patientInviteSms.body: {hospital}: record your movement tests at home with NeuroCapture. Open {link} (works once, {days} days).

reminderEmail.subject: {hospital}: please record your movement tests by {due}
reminderEmail.body:
{hospital} asks you to record your movement tests in the NeuroCapture app by {due}{appointment}.

Open the app, choose {hospital} and tap Start recording.

reminderSms.body: {hospital}: please record your movement tests in the NeuroCapture app by {due}{appointment}.

staffReset.subject: Reset your NeuroCapture sign-in for {hospital}
staffReset.body:
Your NeuroCapture sign-in for {hospital} was reset by {by}.

Choose a new password here (the link works once and expires in {hours} hours):
{link}

After that you will set up two-step sign-in with your authenticator app again.

If you did not ask for this, tell your hospital admin.

testEmail.subject: NeuroCapture test e-mail from {hospital}
testEmail.body:
This is a test from {hospital}'s NeuroCapture connector. E-mail to patients is working.

No reply is needed.

accountCode.subject: Your NeuroCapture code: {code}

appointmentMovedEmail.subject: {hospital}: your appointment is now {when}
appointmentMovedEmail.body:
{hospital} has changed your appointment. It is now on {when}{doctor}.

Open the NeuroCapture app and choose {hospital} to see it. If this time does not suit you, please call {hospital}.

appointmentMovedSms.body: {hospital}: your appointment is now {when}{doctor}. See the NeuroCapture app.

appointmentNotChangedEmail.subject: {hospital}: your appointment date is unchanged
appointmentNotChangedEmail.body:
{hospital} could not move your appointment on {when}. It stays as booked.

Please call {hospital} if you need another date.

appointmentNotChangedSms.body: {hospital}: your appointment on {when} stays as booked. Please call us if you need another date.

appointmentOfferEmail.subject: {hospital}: please choose a new time for your appointment
appointmentOfferEmail.body:
{hospital} needs to move your appointment{when_part}. Open the NeuroCapture app and choose one of the times offered, by {by}.

If none of them suit you, you can ask {hospital} to call you, or cancel the appointment in the app.

appointmentOfferSms.body: {hospital}: please choose a new time for your appointment{when_part} in the NeuroCapture app by {by}.

appointmentCancelledEmail.subject: {hospital}: your appointment on {when} is cancelled
appointmentCancelledEmail.body:
{hospital} has cancelled your appointment on {when}.

To book again, use the NeuroCapture app or call {hospital}.

appointmentCancelledSms.body: {hospital}: your appointment on {when} is cancelled. Book again in the NeuroCapture app or call us.

appointmentBookedEmail.subject: {hospital}: your appointment is booked for {when}
appointmentBookedEmail.body:
{hospital} has booked your appointment for {when}{doctor}.

Open the NeuroCapture app and choose {hospital} to see it.

appointmentBookedSms.body: {hospital}: your appointment is booked for {when}{doctor}. See the NeuroCapture app.

appointmentNotBookedEmail.subject: {hospital}: about your appointment request
appointmentNotBookedEmail.body:
{hospital} could not book the appointment you asked for in the app.

Please call {hospital} to find a time.

appointmentNotBookedSms.body: {hospital}: we could not book the appointment you asked for. Please call us.

doctorNoShow.subject: {hospital}: a patient did not come ({when})
doctorNoShow.body:
A patient did not come to their appointment with you on {when} at {hospital}. The front desk marked it and the appointment is cancelled.

Patient: {ncid} (open them in NeuroCapture to see their name from the hospital's records).

The patient has been told and can book again.

appointmentNoShowEmail.subject: {hospital}: we missed you on {when}
appointmentNoShowEmail.body:
You did not come to your appointment at {hospital} on {when}, so it is cancelled.

To book again, use the NeuroCapture app or call {hospital}.

appointmentNoShowSms.body: {hospital}: you missed your appointment on {when}; it is cancelled. Book again in the NeuroCapture app or call us.
